decisive_arguments: The numerator uses P_A conditioned on the parent; its bound b P(A_j=c) divided by P(A_j=c) r_c v_c cancels the original parent mass. Named comparison weights cannot replace this averaging law.

The angular Taylor remainder becomes O(rho^j/|B-a_0|) in child units and is smaller than rho^a for fixed a<j and slow subpower separation; original upper parent mass divided by lower child mass bounds support counts.
The star is <=(16D)^2 alpha x beta x beta, and a pin-pair likelihood >=eta gives its conditional child <=(16D)^2/eta times alpha. Absolute sine handles antiparallel pairs as well as parallel ones.
Two transverse projection intervals locate the child in rho^((1-tau)a) balls, forcing twice the profile increment to exceed the child rate times (1-tau)a.
Whole-tag sampling, absolute occupancies, degree pruning, finest-cell/tube deduplication and pigeonholing give a selected nice configuration with delta^(-C epsilon) losses and total tubes <= CQL.
Fix output alpha, invoke RW41 with alpha/4, then choose C epsilon below its input allowance and alpha/4, then take delta small. This yields L>=delta^(-min{1,d,(d+u)/2}+alpha).
